<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/rest/api/channelaccounts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the channel accounts configured for your tenant — the WhatsApp numbers, email
addresses and other channel identities you can send from.

The `uuid` of a channel account is the `channelAccountUUID` path parameter of the MT
Messaging API.
